rows: MW: Pumping down string and kill line from cement unit WBM 11.2 ppg @ 0.4 bpm/ 80 psi for friction. Close IBOP and fail safe valve at kill line. Perform surface line pressure test with 300/2000 psi for 5/5 min. Perform hang off at UPR with SO 30 klbf.
MW: Stablish ciculation for PWD data recovering.
MW: Drill new formation 12 1/4" from 3410 to 3418 m with 25 - 30 klbf, 80 rpm / 5 - 20 klbf ft, 850 gpm / 2700 psi, MW 11.2 ppg, ECD 11.43 ppg.

MW: Perform procedure for underreamer activation. POOH from 3418 m to 3410 m. Stop circulation and drop 2" activation ball. RIH till 3417 m (bit 1m above bottom). Circulate WBM 11.2 ppg @ 150 gpm, 210 psi, 30 rpm, 4 klbft, without pressure spike as expected by Halliburton procedure.

MW: Increase flow rate from 150 gpm till 750 gpm / 2290 psi at 50 gpm steps, verifying torq spikes from 400 gpm/760 psi on. Stop circulation and POOH drom 3417 to 3412 m. Perform carry out test against rat hole bottom with 750 gpm / 2260 psi @ 3415 m (bit depth) with 25 klbf.
MW: Perform down link and take SCRs (after reamer activation) with MPs #1 e #2.
MW: Enlarge to 13 1/2" from 3374 até 3377 m with 11 klbf, 45 rpm, 10-35 klb ft, 850 gpm, 2700 psi, MW 11.2 ppg, ECD 11.4 ppg.

MP: Drilling with BHA #4 8 1/2" (PDC Stega and MF), from 5490 m to 5494 m, without rotation. -Parameters: 600 gpm / 2600 psi, 0-5 klbf, 174 rpm (MF) / 18 klbf.ft. Booster at 350 gpm / 720 psi. FPBA 9.0 ppg / ECD 9.75-9.76 ppg. MPD in AP mode (9.8 ppg), SBP 280-300 psi, choke A 49-53%. Obs.: - EDS#4 (CSR+UBSR with EHBS in LBSR).

MP: Drilling with BHA #4 8 1/2" (PDC Stega and MF), from 5494 to 5560 m. -Parameters: 600 gpm / 2400 psi (off) 2500-2700 (on), 10-20 klbf, 15-25 (TD) - 174 rpm (MF) / 19 klbf.ft. Booster at 350 gpm / 720 psi. FPBA 9.0 ppg / ECD 9.84-9.76 ppg. MPD in AP mode (9.80-9.75 ppg), SBP 280-300 psi, choke A 45-50%. - ECD data at connections: - Connection @ 5518 m: MPD in AP mode (9.8 ppg), ECD min 9.72 ppg, ECD med 9.89 ppg, ECD max 9.96 ppg. - Connection @ 5556 m: MPD in AP mode (9.8 ppg), ECD min 9.66 ppg, ECD med 9.84 ppg, ECD max 9.98 ppg.

MP: Observing failure in receiving L/MWD data. Attempting to reset tools and downlink, without success. Obs.: - Sequence of events in troubleshooting: - Trying to reset tool with downlink. - Starting and stopping pumps (MP 1 & 3) at 600 gpm / 2350 psi. - Trying to reset tool with downlink (2x). - Observing abrupt drop of 280 psi in column and stabilization at this level. - Testing NRVs, ok. - Closing IBOP and pressurizing with 500 psi, ok. - Starting and stopping pumps (MP 1 & 3) at 650 gpm / 2300 psi (verifying 2050 psi with 600 gpm). - Starting and stopping pumps (MP 2 & 3) at 650 gpm / 2300 psi. - Starting and stopping pumps (MP 1 & 2) at 700 gpm / 2580 psi (verifying 2070 psi with 600 gpm). - Starting and stopping pumps (MP 1 & 2) at 750 gpm / 2850 psi. - Performing manual mode switch (turn on and off pumps 2x in 3 min interval) with 650 gpm / 2330 psi. - Starting and stopping pumps (MP 1 & 2) at 800 gpm / 3000 psi. - Observing abrupt increase in column pressure to 3300 psi, reducing flow to 600 gpm and observing pressure of 2400 psi, consistent with that observed during drilling. - Starting and stopping pumps (MP 1 & 3) at 600 gpm / 2400 psi. - Trying to reset tool with downlink. - Performing manual mode switch with 650 gpm / 2700 psi. - Trying to reset tool with downlink (2x). - Starting and stopping pumps (MP 1 & 3) at 650 gpm / 2700 psi.

MP: Performing dynamic flow check for 15 min, OK. Pulling 1 section of DP 5 7/8" maintaining SBP 9.8 ppg at shoe + 120 psi. Breaking drilling section. Obs.: - Selecting EDS#5 (CSR+LBSR with EHBS in LBSR).

MP: Pulling BHA #4 of 8 1/2" with mixed string DP 5 1/2" + DP 5 7/8" from 5516 m to 3900 m in open hole and cased hole, with controlled speed of 2 min/section. -Maintaining SBP of 700 psi during trip. -Pulling with bath, manual slips. -Daily cuttings: 753 g -Total phase cuttings: 2538 g - Daily loss to formation: 34 bbl. - Total phase loss to formation: 34 bbl. - Daily drilling rate: 5.8 m/h (70 m in 12 h); - Run/phase drilling rate: 6.0 m/h (96 m in 16.0 h)
